status: frozen after analytic derivation and before executable verification; no holdout or new astronomical target is opened
purpose: Determine whether moving the v17G pressure-channel screen out of the physical metric and into any local monotone shift-symmetric kinetic flux can simultaneously provide an order-unity cluster Weyl field and satisfy the Solar metric-potential bound. Test the conserved exterior charge, not only the locally screened force.

spent_diagnostic_input.use: Verify only that every existing CLASH development point requiring at least an order-unity extra field has g_bar/a_sigma at least 0.1. These are NFW-deprojected diagnostics, not raw lensing evidence.

authorization.allowed_outcome: retain or retire the local monotone shift-symmetric flux-screen class as a Solar-safe completion of the v17G pressure metric

action_class.description: TeVeS-like non-derivative reciprocal pressure metric plus a local AQUAL/K-mouflage-like scalar kinetic flux
action_class.physical_metric: g_tilde_mn=exp(2 alpha X)[g_mn+2 alpha X U_m U_n]
action_class.matter_source: At X=0, J_X=alpha(T+E)=3 alpha p for an isotropic fluid and zero for cold dust
action_class.one_metric_weak_response: Psi=U_N; Phi=U_N-c^2 alpha X; W=U_N-c^2 alpha X/2
action_class.static_field_equation: div[mu(t) g_sigma]=4 pi G alpha^2 rho_p, where rho_p=3p/c^2, t=|g_sigma|/a_sigma, mu(0)=1, mu(t)>0, and mu is monotone nondecreasing
action_class.screen_location: The susceptibility is in the scalar gravitational flux, not in a derivative-dependent matter metric. The v17N transverse matter-Hessian theorem therefore does not apply.
action_class.halo_scale_candidate: For a compact pressure source, the nonlinear radius is r_K=alpha sqrt[G integral(3p/c^2)dV/a_sigma]. It is derived from baryonic pressure compactness and mass rather than fitted per object.

spherical_no_go_theorem.definitions: Pi_p=integral(3p dV)/(M c^2); x=G M/(a_sigma r^2); t=g_sigma/a_sigma; y=r/sqrt(GM/a_sigma)
spherical_no_go_theorem.cluster_requirement: At a development point x_c>=0.1, require g_sigma/g_bar>=1, hence t_c>=x_c
spherical_no_go_theorem.solar_crossing: At the Solar radius y_c where t=x_c, monotonicity and the cluster requirement imply y_c^2>=R/x_c
spherical_no_go_theorem.outer_tail: For y>=y_c, t<=x_c and monotonicity gives t(y)>=R/y^2
spherical_no_go_theorem.potential_lower_bound: U_sigma/U_N=y_obs integral_yobs^infinity t(y)dy >= y_obs sqrt(R x_c)
spherical_no_go_theorem.scope: The theorem assumes a conserved local shift-symmetric exterior flux, a monotone kinetic screen, the v17G reciprocal weak metric, and a range long enough to affect clusters. It does not cover a potential that changes the integrated scalar charge, a nonlocal boundary prescription, or cancellation by a new field.

decision_rule: Retain the class only if the analytic potential lower bound and every representative monotone flux curve satisfy Cassini while supplying an order-unity field at x_c>=0.1.
If the lower bound exceeds Cassini, retire the entire local monotone shift-symmetric kinetic-flux screen for the reciprocal pressure metric; changing the polynomial power is not a new mechanism.
Do not interpret local-force suppression as Solar safety if the conserved outer potential tail fails.

A finite universal range cannot rescue the class if it is long enough to supply the previously declared 12.5 kpc cluster response. A successor must change the integrated Solar scalar charge or reset the pressure-channel mechanism.
